title: DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation
authors: Zhexi Luo, Zhixuan Xu, Rui Yang, Zeyu Xiao, Yiwen Hou, Lin Shao

tldr.zh: DexMimic 用 PPO 联合学习多条人类手物示范的通用跟踪策略，并以 Critic 动态分配训练起点：优先练尚未掌握的阶段，再从该阶段更能持续跟踪的手物状态开始，提高多轨迹学习效率。
tldr.en: DexMimic jointly learns a generalist tracking policy across human hand–object demonstrations with PPO, using its critic to allocate training resets: prioritize under-learned phases, then favor hand–object states within each phase that support continued tracking, improving multi-trajectory training efficiency.

evaluation_scope.zh: 最终为参考条件 MLP 残差策略：根据近期手物状态、物体属性与未来参考目标，输出腕部平移／旋转及手指关节残差，叠加重定向参考的基础动作。训练起点分配仅在训练时使用 Critic 估计；难阶段增加采样，并照顾其之前的准备阶段，同阶段优先选高价值缓存状态且保留原始参考起点采样。主实验为 Wuji 手上的仿真跟踪；Wuji、Inspire、Shadow、Allegro 对照各自训练策略，并非同一权重跨四种手。真机为 7 自由度 xArm＋20 自由度 Wuji 右手，初始化物体位姿后开环回放仿真成功轨迹，未验证该 RL 策略在真机在线闭环控制。
evaluation_scope.en: The final reference-conditioned MLP residual policy takes recent hand–object states, object properties and future reference targets, and outputs wrist translation/rotation and finger-joint residuals added to a retargeted-reference base action. Critic-guided reset allocation is training-only: prioritize difficult phases and their preparation, favor high-value buffered states within the selected phase, and retain reference-anchor sampling. Main experiments track references in simulation with Wuji. Comparisons on Wuji, Inspire, Shadow and Allegro train a separate policy for each hand, rather than sharing weights across all four. Hardware uses a 7-DoF xArm and 20-DoF Wuji right hand to replay successful simulated trajectories open-loop after initial object-pose estimation; online closed-loop deployment of the RL policy on hardware is not demonstrated.
